bootstrap_incremental_gap.estimand: abs(rho(item-centered blackbox excess, whitebox excess)) minus abs(rho(item-centered heuristic, whitebox excess))

feature_protocol.coverage_orientation: fraction of output units recoverable from prompt units
feature_protocol.rouge_l_recall: exact word-token LCS length divided by output word-token count
feature_protocol.whitespace_normalization: collapse Unicode whitespace to one ASCII space

interpretation_limits: This complete-source pilot is not the full frozen corpus.
Correlation after one-variable stratification does not prove semantic dependence.
Surface overlap is an expected mechanism of compression; the estimand is reducibility to simple heuristics.
No learned predictor, embedding model, human judgment, or API call is used.

policy.interpretation: exploratory matched diagnostic, not causal matching
